title: Fat freezing
caption: CoolSculpting is a non-surgical treatment that kills fat cells by cooling them to a temperature that damages fat but leaves the skin above untouched. Dead fat cells are cleared by your body over roughly 8–12 weeks — which is why results appear gradually, not immediately. It targets specific pockets of fat, not overall body weight, so the number on the scale doesn't necessarily change. Knowing that distinction tells you exactly what this treatment can and can't do before you walk into any consultation. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae

slides.headline: Cold kills fat cells
slides.sub: A controlled temperature damages fat tissue while leaving overlying skin unharmed.

slides.headline: Your body clears the rest
slides.sub: Dead fat cells are flushed out gradually — results take 8–12 weeks to show.

slides.headline: Targeted pockets, not weight loss
slides.sub: The scale may not move — this reshapes specific areas, not overall body mass.

slides.headline: One session isn't always enough
slides.sub: Some areas need more than one treatment round to see a visible change.

slides.headline: Know the difference first
slides.sub: Understanding what it targets helps you ask the right questions at any clinic.
